emails.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

Thank you for your message.

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. Our demand forecast for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 is up +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09). That supports a price of about EUR 4.41. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.83 per unit, 45 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
